depth.academicCoordinates: Flat panels; no rotation, translation or perspective.

provenance.artBoundary: Mathematical geometry and topic covers are art; cultural stars are not realtime sky or medical evidence.

evidence.mode: Code-led; no approved comp; no FORM seed.
evidence.sourceInspection: Documentation read source and accepted records; no new live-browser measurement.
evidence.verdictScope: Prior review: original five scored findings and introduced390px Print CV obstruction resolved; no open scored findings. Not whole-surface endorsement.
limitations: Synthetic tonal ramps intentionally omitted: source state palettes are authoritative.
notCanonized: Removed broad Know Me work-face shadow.

academicCoordinateCorrection.scope: Flat downward reveal, complete block text, filled nonuniform grid and content-aware normal flow.
academicCoordinateCorrection.reviewState: UI accepted as match/adaptation; documentation persistence was the sole remaining fix. Documentation synchronized here; no new independent verdict claimed.

academicCoordinates.normalFlow: is-flowing when innerWidth<=700 or blockStage.scrollHeight>viewport-topOffset(); position:relative, top:0, min-height:0, scene height:auto.
academicCoordinates.textIntegrity: flex-shrink:0; overflow-wrap:anywhere; project/honor/book/BUCM descriptions have no hidden or clamped overrides.

narrative.northStar: 学术展厅 / 连续空间叙事
narrative.overview:
This site has two related surface families. The main academic pages are a quiet seasonal exhibition: paper-toned fields, serif display headings, readable records, and publications that can be taken from a shelf. Know Me at /cv/ is a deliberately independent silver/paper, yellow and black spatial narrative, using original line geometry, large bilingual type, sharp frames and continuous native scrolling. The phrase above records the accepted direction; it is not a newly proposed concept.

The durable relationship is scholarly specificity with an accessible reading route. Exhibition pages keep their established seasonal atmosphere; Know Me keeps its user-pinned line-space opening, academic blocks, cinematic journey, approaching works, birth-year and contact ending. These are separate surface grammars, not interchangeable templates. PRODUCT.md supplies content and access constraints, while the shipped CSS and scripts supply the values below.
keyCharacteristics: Two surface families with explicit token namespaces.
Whole-page seasonal palettes on the exhibition; a stable light/dark neutral frame with seasonal accent on Know Me.
Original mathematical line geometry and native scroll-driven perspective.
Public-source records, truthful cover provenance, and direct reading alternatives.
Local fonts/assets, bilingual controls, keyboard/touch routes and reduced-motion reading.

rules.name: Surface Boundary
rules.body: Keep the exhibition and Know Me token families separate. A square spatial CV frame is not a replacement for the established exhibition shelf or folio.

rules.name: Day Ink / Night Silver
rules.body: Know Me switches the entire neutral frame between paper/ink and dark/silver. Seasonal accent changes do not replace the daytime ink token.

rules.name: Native Camera
rules.body: Native vertical scrolling advances the spatial scenes. Preserve document scrolling and the direct controls; do not add wheel or touch scroll interception.

rules.name: Material Depth
rules.body: Keep academic coordinates flat with a downward reveal. Projection, overlap, linework and perspective provide depth in the other Know Me scenes. The exhibition shelf may use its existing physical volume shadows; do not restore the removed broad shadow to Know Me cover faces.

rules.name: Readable Edition
rules.body: System reduction, manual motion-off and focus mode remove long pinned reading and continuous effects. Keep the original records and explicit actions available.

dos: Do use the matching surface namespace and the complete observed mode/season assignments.
Do keep ink text and lines on the light Know Me canvas, silver on dark, and black text on the seasonal accent blocks.
Do preserve the original document records, bilingual chooser initialization, explicit previous/next controls, pause/select/read controls and focus return.
Do retain distinct source labels for verified issue covers, owner-supplied book covers, topic artwork and records without a cover.
Do keep original book pixels and the metadata-defined silhouette crop; put provenance in both the maintained source records and web-image metadata.
Do maintain the shared mobile tool reservation and the readable linear/print paths when extending a scene.
donts: Don't merge the exhibition palettes into the Know Me frame or generalize a page-specific scene into a mandatory global layout.
Don't interpret mathematical geometry as medical evidence or the cultural star chart as a realtime sky.
Don't style generic event-type kickers above cinema headings; the current event kind belongs in the detail paragraph. Retain the explicitly requested SINCE literal.
Don't turn icon-font glyphs or inherited system display faces into a new visual-system rule; extend the local display fonts and inline SVG assets instead.
Don't hide the direct reading routes behind motion, chase-only covers or the opening mark, or fabricate achievements/publication status.
Don't treat the narrow final verdict pass as a fresh whole-surface or live performance endorsement.
